result.summary: The screen is generally functional with minor styling and contrast inconsistencies across cards and banners.

issues.description: Secondary text in the green promotional banner has low contrast against the gradient background.
issues.suggestion: Increase font weight or lighten text color to ensure sufficient contrast.

issues.description: Inconsistent placement and padding of delivery time badges across restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge positioning and internal margins within card image containers.
